scope: Reusable Rust crates, root/standalone Cargo boundaries and representative repository maintenance tooling.
coverage: Listed all current crate source paths and Cargo manifests (excluding broad legacy orientation); read crate entry points, algorithm-testing contract, manifests, and representative scalar/linear algebra, polar/filter/incidence/volume, production capacity/general geometry, legacy orbit contracts, KKT/exact kernels, flow-graph control README, derivatives, data/IO, scripts and dated cost/check sources.
